name: Death They Cried
game_text: <phase>Maneuver</phase>: Spot a mounted <culture>Rohan</culture> Man to exert a minion. That minion's owner may exert a companion and if he or she does so, you may exert a minion; repeat this until a player does not exert a character.
flavor_text: “But the Rohirrim sang no more. Death they cried with one voice....”
